Key.English: Use ALiVE's own values for RHS vests and rifle rounds, so soldiers in RHS body armour go down to a reasonable number of hits. On by default when an RHS mod is loaded. Needs ACE medical with its alternate armour penetration option on (ACE's default); without ACE nothing changes. Off: stock RHS and ACE values. Applies from the next mission start.
With the RHS values on, also give RHS rifle rounds the armour penetration of the matching vanilla cartridge (armour-piercing rounds keep their edge). Off: only the vests change.
With the RHS values on: how the T-14 and T-15 deal with incoming rockets and missiles. RHS stops every one, without limit.
With limited active protection: how many rockets or missiles each tank stops before it must be rearmed.
